h1: Villeroy & Boch bathroom installation on Wentworth Estate

hero.intro: On the private, gated Wentworth Estate in Virginia Water, built around Wentworth Club and the golf courses that host the BMW PGA Championship, the installation itself is only half the planning — coordinating access at the gate with the estate or a managing agent matters just as much to keeping a Villeroy & Boch project on programme. We work fit-only, around 15 to 20 minutes by road from our Bracknell base: you supply the Villeroy & Boch sanitaryware, basins, baths or ViClean shower toilet seats, and we strip out, first-fix, tile, plumb and snag the installation, from £3,500.

sections.heading: Why access planning matters as much as the product spec
sections.body: Deliveries, skips and our fitting team all need to pass through the estate's gate, and on a managed private estate that usually means booking access in advance rather than turning up on the day. Villeroy & Boch's ceramic products are precise but not fragile in transit when handled properly — the real risk to the installation schedule on Wentworth Estate isn't the product, it's a delivery held up at the gate because access wasn't arranged. We build that coordination into the programme from the outset, alongside the usual first-fix and tiling schedule, so the estate's access rules don't become the thing that delays a Villeroy & Boch fit.

sections.heading: Frame and flush plate compatibility, checked before ordering
sections.body: Separately from any access planning, the same product-level detail applies to every Villeroy & Boch WC we install: the brand doesn't manufacture its own carrier frame, so the pan, flush plate and concealed cistern frame need confirming as compatible generations before anything is ordered. We check this against the specification at survey, because a mismatch discovered after the wall is boarded means reopening finished work — on a gated estate where every visit needs coordinating, that's an avoidable delay worth catching early.

sections.heading: What a fit-only installation looks like here
sections.body: A £125 survey starts every project, where we measure the room, check waste and water supply, confirm frame compatibility for whatever's specified, and talk through the estate's access requirements so they're built into the quote rather than added as a surprise later. Installations then start from £3,500 depending on scope. Because we're fit-only, you keep full control over which Villeroy & Boch products you specify and where you source them, while we handle the labour, the coordination with the estate, and the finished fit.

faqs.q: Do you coordinate gate access with the estate for deliveries?
faqs.a: Yes. We build access coordination with the estate or managing agent into the project programme from the outset, alongside the usual first-fix and tiling schedule.

faqs.q: Do you supply Villeroy & Boch products, or just fit them on Wentworth Estate?
faqs.a: We fit only. You source the sanitaryware, basins, baths or ViClean shower toilet seats, and we handle the installation, from £3,500.

faqs.q: Why does the carrier frame need checking before ordering a Villeroy & Boch WC?
faqs.a: Villeroy & Boch doesn't make its own carrier frame, so the pan, flush plate and concealed cistern frame need to be confirmed as matching generations before ordering — we check this at survey, not after the wall is closed up.

faqs.q: How far is Wentworth Estate from your base?
faqs.a: Around 15 to 20 minutes by road from Bracknell.
